extra.reason: Delete-files action added to series rows (list+grid), backed by exporter.delete_series_exports; covered by tests.
Checkbox multi-select + select-all + sticky bar on Exports page, POST /exports/bulk-delete backed by exporter.delete_exports_bulk; covered by tests.
Fixed in app/exporter.py by reusing strm._prune_up(); covered by test_exporter.py::test_delete_series_exports_removes_every_episode.
Shared partials/_actionbar.html shows 'N movie(s) · M TV item(s) selected' via a counts getter on library(), used by both movies.html and tv.html.
Fixed in app/exporter.py::_upsert_export (session.flush() after insert); covered by test_exporter.py::test_same_title_from_two_servers_upserts_one_row and reproduced/verified live via the dev server.
library() now persists selected tokens to localStorage (strmvert.selection) across full-page nav between /movies and /tv; /export already accepted mixed m:/e:/s: tokens.

Movies/TV list+grid rows now show a source picker (dropdown of servers) when the same title+year exists on >1 XC server, with a dynamic exported-status badge; the picked row's own id is what gets written. Also surfaced and fixed a live 500 (export.target_path UNIQUE violation) when duplicates were exported together, and a pre-existing crash pruning an orphaned tvshow.nfo dir.

All 5 library-management features shipped: series/mass delete, cross-tab selection persistence + breakdown counter, and the duplicate-provider stream picker. 76 tests passing, ruff clean, smoke-tested live against a seeded dev server.

Search input on the Exports filter bar calls highlightExports() (vanilla JS) on each keystroke, toggling .row-highlight/.row-dim on matching/non-matching <tr>s by substring match against each row's text.

Episode export titles are now a link opening a drawer (new manager() Alpine component + GET /exports/series/{id}/manage): delete entire series, delete just that episode, and per-episode source switch via POST /exports/{id}/retarget onto a sibling episode (same show+season/ep, different server), upserted onto the same target_path.

Manage drawer offers 'change every episode's source' when a sibling series exists; POST /exports/series/{id}/retarget matches each currently-exported episode to its counterpart on the target server by season/episode number and reports per-episode errors for anything not cached yet.

All 3 sub-features shipped + verified live (curl against a seeded dev server): search highlight, per-episode manage drawer, per-series bulk source switch. Also fixed a bug found while building this: export_episode() never commits on its own (only export_many() does) — the two new retarget endpoints were silently losing their DB writes until I added explicit session.commit().
